results.title: Upcountry Lions maul Ratnam 5-1
results.description: Upcountry Lions SC Nawalapitiya continued their unbeaten run in the FFSL Super League with a convincing 5-1 victory over Ratnam SC in their fifth-round match at the Sugathadasa Stadium in Colombo.

results.title: What happened to Maccabi Haifa’s youth revolution?
results.description: After promising home-grown players first-team roles, Maccabi Haifa turns to veteran depth: "You cannot win titles with nine academy players."
